summary: Tevogen Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing receipt of written notice from Nasdaq on September 9, 2026, confirming the company regained compliance with the $15 million minimum market value of publicly held shares requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(b)(2)(3)(C) for continued listing on the Nasdaq Global Market. The matter is now closed, and no special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are implicated. The filing carries no arbitrage or structural angle; residual risk is future non-compliance, potentially prompting delisting proceedings.
